situation_context.user_goal: support both children and elderly users in shared green space
situation_context.space_character: open community green with walking paths and partial shade

observation: children and elderly rarely share the same area at the same time
benches face inward but no shared anchor
diagnosis: the park supports individual activities but no shared gathering moment

decision.problem: no shared social anchor for multi-generation users
decision.strategy: create one central gathering node with adjacent child and elder zones

principle: shared anchor first, then age-specific secondary zones
boundary: do not apply when the site already has a strong existing anchor
do not apply when child and elder populations cannot be co-located for safety reasons
